name: Scarlett
description:
Made with 100% Brazilian Virgin Remy human hair, she features a medium-brown shadow root that melts into a blend of light brown and sandy dark blonde. Fine beige-blonde highlights run through the back, adding soft dimension while keeping the overall color muted. Her brightest pieces sit right at the hairline, where creamy blonde frames both sides of the face.

All photos are taken in natural lighting. She arrives professionally colored and styled. Care for her as you would your natural hair and touch her up after unboxing if needed.

All sales are final.
features: Bleached knots/ HD Diamond Lace/ Single Knots
